subject: Short‑notice inference shim activation — immediate verification requested
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@optihealth.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 7 Mar 2029 18:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short‑notice inference shim activation — immediate verification requested

Hi Sarah —

We’re deploying a short‑notice compatibility shim to address a small class of tokenization edge cases that surfaced in OptiHealth’s workload this morning (affecting long prompt concatenations and KV cache alignment). This is an unscheduled, low‑risk patch targeted at a subset of inference backends; we will run a brief canary and then roll to your tenant.

What we need from you: could your infra team run two quick smoke checks once we tell you the canary is complete? Specifically: 1) send a representative API request you usually run for summaries (we’ll provide sample input); 2) verify that latency and token counts look normal for three consecutive requests. We expect the canary window to be ~15 minutes.

Timing (today):
- 18:40 PT: start canary on a small pool serving OptiHealth traffic
- 18:55 PT: expand to all OptiHealth nodes if canary is green

We’re attaching the brief release notes (1‑page) and will post status updates to status.redwood.ai. If you’d prefer we hold the rollout, say the word and we’ll queue the change for the next maintenance window. Otherwise, we’ll proceed at 18:40 PT.

Apologies for the short notice — we want to avoid any potential inference divergence during your peak run window later tonight.

Thanks,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: 2029-03-07-inference-shim-release-notes.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Hi all —

Quick update from the eng side: canary started at 18:40 PT as planned on a two‑host pool with traffic mirrored from OptiHealth. We saw the following within the 15‑minute window:
- 0 user‑visible regressions in sampled requests (n=120)
- KV cache alignment warnings dropped from 2.1% -> 0.0% for mirrored workloads
- Median tail latency steady (+4ms) — within SLO

Sarah — sample input we recommend for your smoke tests (shortened):
{
 "prompt": "Patient summary: ... (use your production summary request)"
}

We expanded to the full OptiHealth pool at 18:57 PT after a green canary. Attachments include the 1‑page release notes and the exact canary metrics. Please confirm once your team runs the two checks; if you notice anything unusual, reply immediately and we will rollback the rollout for your tenant.

Sean
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@optihealth.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 8 Mar 2029 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Follow‑up: shim activation complete + short postmortem and verification results

Morning Sarah —

Thanks again for verifying quickly last night. Summary and next steps:

What happened: a rare tokenizer+kv alignment mismatch could produce minor token count drift for very long prompt concatenations. We pushed a compact compatibility shim to correct the alignment in affected runtime paths.

Rollout chronology:
- 18:40 PT (3/7): canary on two hosts (mirrored traffic)
- 18:57 PT (3/7): full tenant rollout after green canary
- 18:58–19:10 PT (3/7): OptiHealth verification window — customer smoke checks completed and reported pass

Customer verification: OptiHealth ran the two checks (representative summary request + three latency samples). Results: token counts match baseline, latency within expected range, no functional regressions observed.

Impact: We observed no customer‑facing regressions in OptiHealth’s traffic. Internal metrics show elimination of the rare alignment warnings.

Follow‑up actions (owned by Redwood):
- OPS: turn the shim into a configurable flag to avoid future unscheduled rollouts (Jira OPS‑9281) — Sean
- ENG: add the failing concatenation case to nightly regression suite — Marissa
- AE: coordinate with OptiHealth on a brief quarterly review to cover safeguards — Tessa

I’ve attached the release notes and the raw canary summary for your records. If you’d like a short call to walk through the canary graphs, tell me a preferred time and we’ll set one up.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
